arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Kerry Scanlon argued Wood's lawyers failed to investigate mental health evidence.
He stated this failure deprived the jury of critical sentencing information.
The state argued counsel made an intelligent decision to limit evidence.
They claimed presenting more evidence might have hurt the defendant's case.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines how courts judge lawyer performance in death penalty trials. It clarifies when failing to investigate evidence violates constitutional rights. The outcome shapes future standards for evaluating defense counsel's strategic choices.
